arxiv-1904-01484.title: Are Query-Based Ontology Debuggers Really Helping Knowledge Engineers? Note: This is a preprint of the work [ 1 ] that is formally published in the Knowledge-Based Systems journal. Journal: ArXiv
arxiv-1904-01484.creator: Patrick Rodler, Dietmar Jannach, Konstantin Schekotihin, Philipp Fleiss
arxiv-1904-01484.description: Abstract Real-world semantic or knowledge-based systems, e.g., in the biomedical domain, can become large and complex. Tool support for the localization and repair of faults within knowledge bases of such systems can therefore be essential for their practical success. Correspondingly, a number of knowledge base debugging approaches, in particular for ontology-based systems, were proposed throughout recent years.

arxiv-2010-03395.title: Thermometry of intermediate level nuclear waste containers in multiple environmental conditions Journal: Measurement
arxiv-2010-03395.creator: J Norman, A Sposito, J L McMillan, W Bond, M Hayes, R Simpson, G Sutton, V Panicker and G Machin, J Jowsey and A Adamska
arxiv-2010-03395.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by J Norman, A Sposito, J L McMillan, W Bond, M Hayes, R Simpson, G Sutton, V Panicker and G Machin, J Jowsey and A Adamska. Intermediate level nuclear waste must be stored until it is safe for permanent disposal. Temperature monitoring of waste packages is important to the nuclear decommissioning industry to support management of each package.

arxiv-2101-08726.title: High-accuracy longitudinal position measurement using self-accelerating light
arxiv-2101-08726.creator: Shashi Prabhakar, Stephen Plachta, Marco Ornigotti, Robert Fickler
arxiv-2101-08726.description: Abstract Radially self-accelerating light exhibits an intensity pattern that describes a spiraling trajectory around the optical axis as the beam propagates. In this article, we show in simulation and experiment how such beams can be used to perform a high-accuracy distance measurement with respect to a reference using simple off-axis intensity detection.

arxiv-2109-04003.title: Improving Deep Metric Learning by Divide and Conquer
arxiv-2109-04003.creator: Artsiom Sanakoyeu, Pingchuan Ma, Vadim Tschernezki, and Björn Ommer
arxiv-2109-04003.description: Abstract Deep metric learning (DML) is a cornerstone of many computer vision applications. It aims at learning a mapping from the input domain to an embedding space, where semantically similar objects are located nearby and dissimilar objects far from another. The target similarity on the training data is defined by user in form of ground-truth class labels.

arxiv-2308-04620.title: Multiclass Online Learnability under Bandit Feedback Equal contribution
arxiv-2308-04620.creator: Ananth Raman, Vinod Raman, Unique Subedi, Idan Mehalel, Ambuj Tewari
arxiv-2308-04620.description: Abstract We study online multiclass classification under bandit feedback. We extend the results of Daniely and Helbertal 2013 by showing that the finiteness of the Bandit Littlestone dimension is necessary and sufficient for bandit online learnability even when the label space is unbounded.

arxiv-2311-06039.title: Adaptation rules inducing synchronization of heterogeneous Kuramoto oscillator network with triadic couplings
arxiv-2311-06039.creator: Anastasiia A. Emelianova, Vladimir I. Nekorkin
arxiv-2311-06039.description: Abstract A class of adaptation functions is found for which a synchronous oscillation mode exists in the network of phase oscillators with triadic couplings. It is shown that the destruction of the synchronous mode occurs differently for networks with pairwise couplings and with higher-order interactions. In the first case, a chimera state is realized.

arxiv-2312-09424.title: Open Domain Knowledge Extraction for Knowledge Graphs
arxiv-2312-09424.creator: Kun Qian, Anton Belyi, Fei Wu, Samira Khorshidi, Azadeh Nikfarjam, Rahul Khot, Yisi Sang, Katherine Luna, Xianqi Chu, Eric Choi, Yash Govind, Chloe Seivwright, Yiwen Sun, Ahmed Fakhry, Theo Rekatsinas, Ihab Ilyas, Xiaoguang Qi, Yunyao Li
arxiv-2312-09424.description: Abstract The quality of a knowledge graph directly impacts the quality of downstream applications (e.g. the number of answerable questions using the graph). One ongoing challenge when building a knowledge graph is to ensure completeness and freshness of the graph’s entities and facts.

arxiv-2410-09865.title: SynFER: Towards Boosting Facial Expression Recognition with Synthetic Data
arxiv-2410-09865.creator: Xilin He, Cheng Luo, Xiaole Xian, Bing Li, Siyang Song, Muhammad Haris Khan, Weicheng Xie, Linlin Shen, Zongyuan Ge, Shenzhen University AIM Lab, Faculty of IT, Monash University KAUST, ∗ * Equal Contribution Corresponding Author
arxiv-2410-09865.description: Abstract Facial expression datasets remain limited in scale due to privacy concerns, the subjectivity of annotations, and the labor-intensive nature of data collection. This limitation poses a significant challenge for developing modern deep learning-based facial expression analysis models, particularly foundation models, that rely on large-scale data for optimal performance.

arxiv-2502-18971.title: The bolometric Bond albedo and energy balance of Uranus
arxiv-2502-18971.creator: Patrick G. J. Irwin, Daniel D. Wenkert, Amy A. Simon, Emma Dahl, Heidi B. Hammel
arxiv-2502-18971.description: Abstract Using a newly developed ‘holistic’ atmospheric model of the aerosol structure in Uranus’s atmosphere, based upon observations made by HST/STIS, Gemini/NIFS and IRTF/SpeX from 2000 – 2009, we make a new estimate the bolometric Bond albedo of Uranus during this time of A ∗ = 0.338 ± 0.011 A^{*}=0.338\pm 0.

arxiv-2504-16041.title: Muon Optimizer Accelerates Grokking
arxiv-2504-16041.creator: Amund Tveit, Bjørn Remseth, Arve Skogvold
arxiv-2504-16041.description: Abstract Abstract This paper investigates the impact of different optimizers on the grokking phenomenon, where models exhibit delayed generalization. We conducted experiments across seven numerical tasks (primarily modular arithmetic) using a modern Transformer architecture. The experimental configuration systematically varied the optimizer (Muon vs.

arxiv-2505-01664.title: Soft-Masked Semi-Dual Optimal Transport for Partial Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2505-01664.creator: Yi-Ming Zhai, Chuan-Xian Ren, Hong Yan
arxiv-2505-01664.description: Abstract Visual domain adaptation aims to learn discriminative and domain-invariant representation for an unlabeled target domain by leveraging knowledge from a labeled source domain. Partial domain adaptation (PDA) is a general and practical scenario in which the target label space is a subset of the source one.

arxiv-2505-15276.title: When Can Large Reasoning Models Save Thinking? Mechanistic Analysis of Behavioral Divergence in Reasoning
arxiv-2505-15276.creator: Rongzhi Zhu, Yi Liu, Jiancheng Wang, Xiangyu Liu, Zequn Sun, Yiwei Wang, Yu Deng, Zijian Zhou, Wei Hu
arxiv-2505-15276.description: Abstract Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable success on complex tasks, yet their tendency to “overthink” leads to inefficiencies. Although “save-thinking” prompts are intended to mitigate this issue, we find that LRMs still frequently enter the “Still-thinking” mode instead of the expected “No-thinking” mode, especially on difficult queries.

arxiv-2508-17877.title: Edge-Enhanced Vision Transformer Framework for Accurate AI-Generated Image Detection
arxiv-2508-17877.creator: Dabbrata Das, Mahshar Yahan, Md Tareq Zaman, Md Rishadul Bayesh
arxiv-2508-17877.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of generative models has led to a growing prevalence of highly realistic AI-generated images, posing significant challenges for digital forensics and content authentication. Conventional detection methods mainly rely on deep learning models that extract global features, which often overlook subtle structural inconsistencies and demand substantial computational resources.

arxiv-2508-20949.title: Stable and practical semi-Markov modelling of intermittently-observed data
arxiv-2508-20949.creator: Christopher Jackson
arxiv-2508-20949.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christopher Jackson. Multi-state models are commonly used for intermittent observations of a state over time, but these are generally based on the Markov assumption, that transition rates are independent of the time spent in current and previous states. In a semi-Markov model, the rates can depend on the time spent in the current state, though available methods for this are either restricted to specific state structures or lack general software.

arxiv-2602-17227.title: Quantum key distribution over a metropolitan network using an integrated photonics based prototype
arxiv-2602-17227.creator: Maria Ana Pereira, Giulio Gualandi, Rebecka Sax, Alberto Boaron, Raphaël Houlmann, Roberto Osellame, Rob Thew, Hugo Zbinden
arxiv-2602-17227.description: Abstract An industrial-scale adoption of QKD ( QKD ) requires the development of practical, stable, resilient and cost-effective hardware that can be manufactured at large scales. In this work we present a high-speed (1.25 GHz \mathrm{GHz} ), field-deployable QKD prototype based on integrated photonics, that is consolidated into standard 19-inch rack compatible units.

pmc-10671643.title: Antimicrobial and Cytotoxic Activities of Water-Soluble Isoxazole-Linked 1,3,4-Oxadiazole with Delocalized Charge: In Vitro and In Vivo Results
pmc-10671643.creator: Bartłomiej Dudek, Urszula Bąchor, Ewa Drozd-Szczygieł, Malwina Brożyna, Piotr Dąbrowski, Adam Junka, Marcin Mączyński
pmc-10671643.description: The distinct structure of cationic organic compounds plays a pivotal role in enhancing their water solubility, which in turn influences their bioavailability. pmc-10688122.title: Local low‐frequency vibration accelerates healing of full‐thickness wounds in a hyperglycemic rat model
pmc-10688122.creator: Daijiro Haba, Qi Qin, Chihiro Takizawa, Sanai Tomida, Takeo Minematsu, Hiromi Sanada, Gojiro Nakagami
pmc-10688122.description: Aims/IntroductionLocal low‐frequency vibration (LLFV) promotes vasodilation and blood flow, enhancing wound healing in diabetic foot ulcers with angiopathy. However, vibration‐induced vasodilation does not occur, owing to chronic hyperglycemia and inflammation. We hypothesized that LLFV improves glycometabolism and inflammation, leading to vasodilation and angiogenesis in diabetic wounds.

pmc-11437729.title: Navigating delayed diagnoses, self-neglect, and lost livelihoods: a qualitative exploration of fisherfolk’s health perspectives and management of non-communicable diseases in Kerala, India
pmc-11437729.creator: Surya Surendran, Gloria Benny, Jaison Joseph, Devaki Nambiar
pmc-11437729.description: IntroductionNon-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) place a significant burden on India's healthcare system, accounting for approximately 62% of all deaths in the country in 2017. The southern Indian state - Kerala - has some of the highest rates of NCDs. Within the state, the fisherfolk community has a high prevalence of risk factors such as tobacco use and alcohol consumption.

pmc-11455897.title: Using machine learning to understand social isolation and loneliness in schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and the community
pmc-11455897.creator: Samuel J Abplanalp, Michael F Green, Jonathan K Wynn, Naomi I Eisenberger, William P Horan, Junghee Lee, Amanda McCleery, David J Miklowitz, L Felice Reddy, Eric A Reavis
pmc-11455897.description: Social disconnection, including objective social isolation and subjective loneliness, is linked to substantial health risks. Yet, little is known about the predictors of social disconnection in individuals with mental illness. Here, we used machine learning to identify predictors of social isolation and loneliness in schizophrenia (N = 72), a psychiatric condition associated with social disconnection.

pmc-11470870.title: Regulation of pro-apoptotic and anti-apoptotic factors in obesity-related esophageal adenocarcinoma
pmc-11470870.creator: Swati Agrawal, Anna Podber, Megan Gillespie, Nick Dietz, Laura A Hansen, Kalyana C Nandipati
pmc-11470870.description: BackgroundObesity is a risk factor for esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC). It was reported that obesity -associated inflammation correlates with insulin resistance and increased risk of EAC. The objective of the study is to investigate the role of obesity associated inflammatory mediators in the development of EAC.

pmc-12581481.title: From prediction to action: a retrospective observational study on the real-world implementation of Critical Interventions (CrIs), an AI-based clinical decision support system changing clinical behavior in the emergency department

pmc-12581481.description: BackgroundOptimal emergency department (ED) care for critically ill patients relies on prompt recognition and initiation of necessary interventions. The Critical Interventions (CrIs) system was designed to predict the need for urgent procedures, including arterial line insertion, oxygen therapy, high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC), intubation, and inotropes or vasopressors, based solely on triage data.

pmc-12831265.title: Performance and injury-related effects of low-load blood flow restriction training in amateur soccer players: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12831265.creator: Begüm Kara Kaya, Ayşe Zengin Alpözgen, Mehmet Rahmi Alpözgen, Göksel Dikmen
